Author: Valentina Vieri
Name: VieriLink
Punchline: Private Discord status, notifications, and remote control for VieriAutoDuty.
Description: Connects one FFXIV character to one private Discord channel. Maintains a configurable live VieriAutoDuty status message, sends selected notifications, and accepts allowlisted remote commands with acknowledgements and an audit trail. Requires VieriAutoDuty for automation controls.
